description: 只按事前字段计划转换已有同源程序，原源码不改；生成后的完整程序先保存再执行。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'
old=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1/01_外需字段来源与完整支持执行记录.json'
source=json.loads(old.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['executed_source']
replacements=[
('510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1','510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'),
('新出口订单水平','采购量水平'),
('新出口订单月度变化','采购量月度变化'),
('new_export_orders','purchase_quantity'),
("lookup[r['stat_month']]==r['purchase_quantity']","lookup[r['stat_month']]==r['purchases']"),
('新出口订单','采购量'),
('old_15_month_export_values_identical','old_15_month_purchase_values_identical'),
('FIXED_DAILY_EXPORT_CONDITION_USE','FIXED_DAILY_PURCHASE_CONDITION_USE'),
('new_export_causal_identification','purchase_motive_causal_identification'),
("'experiment_id':'E26'","'experiment_id':'E36'"),
('外需','采购'),
('出口','采购')]
for a,b in replacements:
 assert a in source,'旧程序中缺少事前定位项：'+a
 source=source.replace(a,b)
assert "header.index('采购量')" in source and "r['purchases']" in source
assert "['采购量水平','采购量月度变化']" in source
p=OUT/'01_采购字段来源与完整支持执行记录.json'
assert not p.exists(),'来源执行已存在，不重跑。'
p.write_text(json.dumps({'description':'固定事前采购量候选；复用旧来源程序结构，完整生成程序在执行前保存。','based_on':str(old.relative_to(ROOT)),'transformations':replacements,'executed_source':source},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
try:
 exec(compile(source,str(p),mode='exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
except Exception as e:
 for name,obj in [
 ('source_gate_failure.json',{'status':'SOURCE_GATE_FAILED_NO_MODEL_ADMISSION','at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'error_class':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e),'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0}),
 ('result.json',{'study_id':'510300_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_CAUSE_INCREMENT_V1','experiment_id':'E36','status':'STOPPED_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED','error_class':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e),'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False})]:
  p=OUT/name
  if not p.exists():p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 raise
